rulebook.title: The Jester
rulebook.pitch: Wins alone if executed, so every execution becomes a gamble.

details.label: Goal
text: You play for nobody. You win if you are executed: the game ends at once and only you win. Every execution counts, by a President, by Confession, by the Anarchist or by the Fascist Spy.

details.label: What you know
text: Nobody. You keep your eyes closed through the whole night.

details.label: Your Fascist card
text: You hold a Fascist membership card, so any investigation shows Fascist and Radicalisation never turns you. That is your best tool for looking guilty.

details.label: Danger
text: If any team wins before someone executes you, you lose. A player who works out that you are the Jester will never shoot you.

details.label: How to play it
text: Look suspicious, but not too obviously. Never claim to be the Jester.
